commits.message:
lint quality bundle: dedup storage-loop warnings, branch storage-in-loop help, detect host calls in iterator closures, document --config (Closes #127 #128 #129 #130)

Issues consolidated onto a single branch (one PR, four issues) per request. All four are pure code/docs changes; no new dependencies.

* Closes #127 — soroban_storage_in_loop differentiates help text for reads (.get/.has) vs writes (.set); docs page split accordingly.

* Closes #128 — unnecessary_host_function_call now fires for host calls inside multi-call iterator closures via a new enclosing_loop_or_closure helper (storage / HostInLoop kept on the loop-only helper by design).

* Closes #129 — soroban_storage_in_loop collapses overlapping warnings on chained storage calls (env.storage().instance().set(&k, &v)) by gating on terminal-op method names only.

* Closes #130 — README and docs/integration.md document the --config <PATH> CLI flag, its absence-of-default behaviour, and relative/absolute-path examples.

Verified: cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, and the dylint UI snapshot (BLESS=1 cycle) all pass on the pinned nightly-2026-04-16 toolchain.
